title: pvCellSize
body:
## pvCellSize

Full native Cell Size filter: adds cell-data arrays with the point count of 0-D cells (VertexCount), the length of 1-D cells (Length), the area of 2-D cells (Area) and the volume of 3-D cells (Volume), in dataset coordinate units. Cells of other dimensions get 0 in each array. With ComputeSum the totals per array are also stored as one-value field-data arrays of the same names; for composite input the top-level output holds the sum over all blocks. Use it instead of cellSize when you need custom array names or to switch off the vertex count.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Ghost cells receive per-cell values but are excluded from the sums.
- Nothing is converted: a mesh in millimetres gives areas in square millimetres.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CellSize`. Identity: `filters/CellSize`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Size filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AreaArrayName` | Specify the name of the array to store 2D cell area and optionally the field data area sum. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ComputeArea` | Specify whether or not to compute the area of 2D cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeLength` | Specify whether or not to compute the length of 1D cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeSum` | Specify whether or not to sum the computed sizes of cells in datasets. The result is stored in field data. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeVertexCount` | Specify whether or not to compute the number of points in 0D cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeVolume` | Specify whether or not to compute the volume of 3D cells . | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LengthArrayName` | Specify the name of the array to store the 1D cell length and optionally the field data length sum. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `VertexCountArrayName` | Specify the name of the array to store the 0D cell vertex count and optionally the field data vertex count sum. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `VolumeArrayName` | Specify the name of the array to store 3D cell volume and optionally the field data volume sum. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
